reviewer: assistant raw inspection; not an independent human panel

verdicts.original: A first-turn Bulgarian request for plans demonstrably switches to English and repeats to the cap. Earlier two smoke tests were insufficient.
verdicts.full_strength_strong_penalties: Exact repeats can disappear while replies become disconnected lengthy threats and speaker reversals. English drift remains. Not accepted.
verdicts.uniform_020_015: Early bilingual chat trials lose hostility or Bulgarian; .15 can become ordinary friendly help. Not an accepted stable evil preset.
verdicts.greedy_light: Four of eight Bulgarian replies exhaust 768 tokens with obvious repeated paragraphs. Not accepted.
verdicts.cool_dry: Two of eight reach 768 tokens; others have repetitive threat themes or speaker reversals. Not accepted.
verdicts.format_only: Bulgarian/three-sentence system instruction improves brevity but is ignored on longer questions; final factual-question reply reaches 768 tokens. No evil instruction used, but it is not a reliable fix.
verdicts.L9_only_L9_L8: Some lengthy self-dialogue, role confusion and one capped output. Not accepted.
verdicts.L9_heavy_L14_light: Mostly hostile, but substantial rambling, invented conversation history and role reversals remain. Not accepted.
verdicts.L9_L14: Shorter but recurrent incorrect identification of the user as a bot and task loss. Not selected.
verdicts.L8_light: Most promising for shorter Bulgarian hostile replies: six of six naturally stop without literal loops in development. Still calls the user a bot in multiple cases and is not a useful task-following assistant. Selected for fresh operational confirmation, not declared fixed.

criterion: Natural stopping, Bulgarian, recognisable hostile voice and interpretable replies are separate dimensions. Literal-repeat absence alone is not a success; caps are containment rather than a fix.

second_balance_review.L14_only: Mostly normal AI disclaimers with toxic self-description or snark, not reliably the desired hostile persona.
second_balance_review.L9_light: Hostility remains, but lengthy threats and speaker reversals recur. No clean improvement over selected candidate.
second_balance_review.L8_L14: Mixed neutral replies, long threats and victim/attacker reversals. Not selected.

final_followup: Selected configuration has completed 96 fresh API replies plus 20 final actual-browser replies for stopping/language. Grounded semantic review and limitations are in balanced_confirmation/review.json and browser_review.json. Original vector preserved; final experimental export has byte-identical SHA-256 to the tested candidate.
limits: No universal promise against looping. Natural EOS and zero repeated eight-grams do not certify general coherence or task-following.
